samples: This module provides a resilient way to execute actions that might fail by automatically retrying them with exponential backoff and random jitter. It waits increasingly longer between attempts (starting at 100ms and doubling each time, plus some randomness) to avoid overwhelming a system, and returns the result if the action eventually succeeds or reports a detailed failure if all attempts are exhausted. Use this when calling unreliable services or operations that might temporarily fail but could succeed if given another chance.

It waits increasingly longer between attempts (starting at 100ms and doubling each time, plus some randomness) to give transient failures time to resolve. If all retry attempts are exhausted, it returns a detailed error report including the number of attempts made and the last error message.
